derived_from.human_pilot_role: development evidence only; not gold labels or reliability evidence

research_object: Visible language in deidentified adult-film titles
inference_boundary: Code only language visible in the title.
Do not infer video content, real identities, real relationships, real age, consent, harm, or causality.
A relationship label never automatically creates an age or harm label.
An absence label means no visible title cue, not proof that the real-world attribute is absent.

output_policy.presence_fields: derived from substantive labels; the model must not predict them separately
output_policy.unknown: relevant evidence exists but cannot be assigned stably; it may coexist with known labels
output_policy.other: the construct is visibly present but no listed substantive label covers it
output_policy.not_applicable: used only when record_validity is technical_noise or unknown
output_policy.confidence: not collected as a paper label

options.definition: The title contains text that can be analysed as a research record.
The record is only a parsing remnant, URL, serial marker, crawl error, or other non-title content.
The visible text is insufficient to decide whether the record is analysable.
An explicit father/father-generation male and daughter/daughter-generation female role pairing.
options.exclude: A lone father or daughter, a different in-law pairing, or an isolated marketing nickname. This code does not prove age, a real relationship, taboo, or harm.

options.definition: An explicit mother/mother-generation female and son/son-generation male role pairing.
options.exclude: A lone mother or son, a different in-law pairing, or an isolated marketing nickname. This code does not prove age, a real relationship, taboo, or harm.

options.definition: An explicit current or former non-marital romantic partner relationship.
options.exclude: Spouses belong to family_marriage; ordinary friends belong to intimate_peer_community; an ambiguous lover term requires context. Dating does not itself imply betrayal or harm.

options.definition: A residual family, kinship, in-law, marital, or household-family position other than father_daughter or mother_son.
options.exclude: Do not duplicate S01 or S02 for the same cue. This residual category is not a complete or homogeneous kinship taxonomy.

options.definition: A friend, acquaintance, peer, neighbour, co-resident, or other close/community relationship other than an explicit dating partner.
options.exclude: Do not duplicate S03 for the same cue; spouses belong to S04.

options.definition: A student, teacher, school, teaching, or educational-training position.
options.exclude: Costume alone is insufficient. Sexual discipline described as training is not education without an educational context.

options.definition: An occupation, supervisor/subordinate, employment, recruitment, or organisational position.
options.exclude: A costume alone is insufficient.

options.definition: A medical, nursing, treatment, caregiving, or care-recipient position.
options.exclude: Clothing or role-play without a medical/care context is insufficient.

options.definition: A service, customer, paid-contact, commercial exchange, or economic-support relationship.
options.exclude: Ordinary payment does not itself imply threat, coercion, or authority pressure.

options.definition: A platform, streamer, performer, producer, photographer, or dissemination-production role.
options.exclude: Generic words such as video or filming do not suffice unless a media, platform, performance, or production identity is visible.

options.definition: A law-enforcement, detention, religious, military, or other public-institution position.
options.exclude: An isolated uniform or active-duty marketing phrase without institutional context is insufficient.

options.definition: An explicitly socialised adult-age, marital/reproductive, class, or gender-expectation position.
options.exclude: A demographic adjective, youthful marketing, or minor-age cue alone is insufficient. This heterogeneous code is exploratory until a theory specifies its use.

options.definition: An explicit master, subordinate, servant, pet, or comparable hierarchy identity.
options.exclude: A hierarchy identity does not itself imply non-consent or a domination/discipline act.

fields.aggregate_warning: The parent codes span direct harm, coercion, privacy violations, domination, aggressive style, and relational boundary scripts. Do not sum them into an unqualified severity score.

options.definition: Explicit force, assault, refusal, resistance, violation of will, or non-consent.
options.exclude: Domination, BDSM, intensity, status difference, or missing consent language alone is insufficient.

options.definition: Visible language of incapacity or deception that weakens informed judgement or ability to consent.
options.exclude: Ambiguous mild intoxication or unclear wording is insufficient without a visible incapacity/deception mechanism.

options.definition: Explicit hitting, choking, torture, injury, pain, or fear-result language.
options.exclude: Intense sexual style without attack, pain, injury, or fear language is insufficient.

options.definition: Explicit binding, confinement, device restraint, movement restriction, or control of liberty.
options.exclude: Restraint does not automatically imply force_nonconsent.

options.definition: A threat, debt, resource, occupational power, or authority is visibly used as a condition, pressure, or control mechanism.
options.exclude: A boss, sponsor, teacher, paid service, or status difference alone is insufficient.

options.definition: The title claims covert capture/surveillance, distribution of private intimate material, or exposure of personal identifying information.
options.exclude: Self-publication, ordinary public filming, publicity, or performance without a privacy-violation claim is insufficient.

options.definition: An explicit domination, submission, discipline, punishment, kneeling, or pet-treatment act.
options.exclude: An identity label alone is insufficient; this code does not automatically imply force_nonconsent.

options.definition: A person is explicitly insulted, dehumanised, instrumentalised, fragmented into body parts, or framed as freely usable.
options.exclude: An isolated swear word, colloquial act name, or body word that does not demean a person is insufficient.

options.definition: Sexual activity is organised through explicit ruthless, mechanical, extreme, group-use, or comparable aggressive-use language.
options.exclude: Physical aggression and non-consent must be coded separately and cannot be inferred from intensity alone.

options.definition: An independent visible cue explicitly claims kinship taboo, partner betrayal, or exploitation of a close relationship.
options.exclude: Father-daughter, mother-son, another kinship term, marriage, or dating alone never triggers H10; an independent taboo, betrayal, infidelity, boundary-crossing, or relationship-leverage cue is required.

options.definition: The title states a numeric age below 18 in a person-age context, uses an unambiguous minor/child legal-age identity term, or explicitly names a PRC compulsory-education stage limited here to primary or junior-high school. This is a title-language code and never establishes a real person's age.
options.exclude: Kinship, generic student/campus language, senior-high school, youthful appearance, and role-play do not by themselves qualify.

options.definition: The title uses child-coded, non-tertiary/generic student, school-stage, role-play/costume, or youthful-marketing cues without enough evidence for explicit minor reference.
options.exclude: An explicitly university/adult student without another youth cue is absent, not suggestive.

options.definition: No visible minor-age or youth-coding cue appears; this does not prove adulthood.
Age-relevant evidence exists, but its wording or referent is too ambiguous to distinguish explicit, suggestive, or absent.
Used only when the record is technical noise or record validity is unknown.
A numeric age below 18 in a person-age context; years, episode numbers, and durations do not count.
An unambiguous minor, child, or legal-age-status term.
A child-coded or youth role term whose real age is not established.

A tertiary-ambiguous or age-indeterminate school/student/campus cue (e.g. 学生/校园/高中 or an unspecified stage); an explicit university/adult student alone does not count. Excludes compulsory_education_stage (AC08).
An explicit school-age-coded costume or role-play cue; a generic occupational uniform alone does not count.
Childlike appearance, youthful appearance, tenderness/youngness, or similar marketing language; it never proves real age.
Another visible age-relevant cue not covered above; a short description and evidence span are required.

A specific PRC compulsory-education-stage term limited to 小学 or 初中. It supports an explicit title-level minor reference, not an inference about a real person's age. 高中 and generic student/campus language remain AC04 because they are age-ambiguous.

dependency_rules.then: all semantic code arrays are empty and minor_age_reference_status=not_applicable
minor_age_cue_types contains numeric_under_18 or explicit_minor_term or compulsory_education_stage
minor_age_cue_types is nonempty and excludes numeric_under_18 and explicit_minor_term and compulsory_education_stage
at least one allowed mechanism for that parent is selected

dependency_rules.if: a parent harm code is absent
a substantive code or cue is selected
dependency_rules.then: at least one exact private evidence span and the matching rule_id are supplied
description and exact evidence span are required
at least one short adjudication reason is required

freeze_basis.frozen_interpretive_boundary: Visible title language only; no inference to real age, relationship, consent, harm, or video content.
